gacc_sections.narrative: Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (AK Team 1). Ten miles northwest of Rye, CO. Timber and medium slash. Active fire behavior with short crown runs, wind-driven runs and spotting. Numerous residences threatened. Area and road closures in effect. Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 3). Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and closed timber litter. Active fire behavior with short crown runs, uphill runs and group torching. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active fire behavior with wind-driven runs, flanking and short-range spotting. Numerous structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. CIMT (SW Team 4). Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. Moderate fire behavior with flanking, group torching and short-range spotting. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Sheep Head, Huerfano County. Twenty-two miles northwest of Walsenburg, CO. Brush, timber and grass. Moderate fire behavior with creeping, isolated torching and flanking. Residences and energy infrastructure threatened. Log Road, Nebraska Forest Service. Twelve miles northwest of Crawford, NE. Timber, grass and light slash. Moderate fire behavior with wind-driven runs, torching and spotting. Structures threatened.

Cottonwood, Fishlake NF, USFS. CIMT (GB Team 5). Five miles east of Beaver, UT. Timber, brush and light slash. Active fire behavior with torching, short-range spotting and short crown runs. Numerous structures and energy infrastructure threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Babylon, Manti-La Sal NF, USFS. CIMT (GB Team 2). Twenty-five miles southwest of Monticello, UT. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. Extreme fire behavior with crowning, wind-driven runs and running. Structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Wild Goose, Fishlake NF, USFS. CIMT (GB Team 7). Twelve miles northeast of Fillmore, UT. Timber, brush and grass. Active fire behavior with group torching, short-range spotting and backing. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Grapevine, Ely District, BLM. Ten miles southeast of Caliente, NV. Timber, brush and chaparral. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Structures threatened. Area closures in effect. Iron, Central Area, Utah DOF. CIMT (GB Team 3). CIMT is also managing the Cherry incident. One mile northwest of Eureka, UT. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Area and road closures in effect. Cherry, West Desert District, BLM. Twenty-nine miles southwest of Santaquin, UT. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, isolated torching and smoldering. Residences and critical infrastructure threatened. Area and road closures in effect. Parsnip Peak, Ely District, BLM. Eighteen miles northwest of Pioche, NV. Timber and brush. Active fire behavior with group torching and backing. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. Kinky Creek, Bridger-Teton NF, USFS. Thirty-four miles northwest of Cora, WY. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Residences threatened. Area closures in effect. Snyder, Desert Rivers Fire and Aviation Management Unit, BLM. CIMT (RM Team 1). Thirteen miles west of Grand Junction, CO. Grass and brush. Minimal fire behavior with wind-driven runs, creeping and single tree torching. Numerous residences and communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. Dry Canyon, Ely District, BLM. Fourteen miles east of Pioche, NV. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Kane Springs, Ely District, BLM. Seventeen miles southwest of Caliente, NV. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Last report unless significant activity occurs. Horse Head, Desert Rivers Fire and Aviation Management Unit, BLM. Seven miles southwest of Eastland, UT. Dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Last report unless significant activity occurs.

Numerous structures and energy infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Beehive, Carson NF, USFS. Fifteen miles northeast of Tres Piedras, NM. Timber. Sycamore, Tonto NF, USFS. Fifteen miles north of Globe, AZ. Grass and brush. Minimal fire behavior with flanking, backing and creeping. Area and road closures in effect. Canyon Venado, Bernalillo District, NM State Forestry. Five miles east of Clines Corner, NM. Timber and grass. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Energy infrastructure threatened.

Shingle Creek, Craig Mountain Supervisory Area Office, IDL. Transfer of command from CIMT (NR Team 1) back to the local unit will occur today. Six miles southwest of Riggins, ID. Timber and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Numerous structures threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday.
